Cost: 50eb (Costly)
Class: PQ Medium Pistol
Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Pistol Autosear (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 3), Suppressive Fire

Single Shot fires a 3-round burst (empties the magazine if fewer remain). Autofire uses 6 rounds, not 10 (Efficient Autosear). On a Critical Failure the gun is Destroyed Beyond Repair; if that happens during Autofire it also blows up in hand after the attack resolves, inflicting Crushed Fingers on that hand (a Cyberhand ignores the effect but still takes the Bonus Damage). Can't take a Smartgun Link or any Rebuild.

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
